extra.content_scope: Complete quarterly opening overview, management statements and capital-return narrative; Microsoft additionally includes all segment/business financial highlights and the available outlook paragraph. No sentiment-based selection.
extra.extraction_method: One-time selection of complete narrative blocks from eight explicit official HTML pages; entities decoded, whitespace collapsed, unpunctuated bullets kept as paragraphs, duplicates removed. No crawler added.
extra.excluded_content: Navigation, headings, numerical tables, webcast logistics, repeated corporate description, legal boilerplate and standalone annual-results section.
extra.extraction_limitations: No equivalent segment-business-highlights or separate outlook narrative appears before webcast logistics. Full-year comments in opening Q4 management remarks are retained. Legal risk boilerplate and financial-statement PDFs are excluded.
extra.rights_notes: Source and derived text remain local and ignored by Git; public access does not establish redistribution permission.
